crossRefs.note: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

people.name: Hamath
people.line: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.

people.name: Tadmor
people.line: City built by Solomon in the wilderness

translations.web: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.
translations.bsb: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, in addition to all the store cities that he had built in Hamath.
translations.kjv: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
translations.asv: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store-cities, which he built in Hamath.
